## User problem

Who needs this, and what editing task is currently difficult or impossible?

## Proposed result

Describe the desired observable behavior and how it fits the existing engine/workspace.

## Alternatives

What have you tried? Link related issues and avoid unrelated features in the same proposal.

## Boundaries and acceptance

- How would we verify the result?
- Privacy, consent, storage/backup compatibility and licensing impacts:
- Browser/native codec, accessibility and performance implications:
- New services/dependencies or paid-provider prerequisites:

Read the [roadmap](https://github.com/WilsonLe/LocalCut/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md) and [contributor guide](https://github.com/WilsonLe/LocalCut/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). A proposal is not a release promise. Do not include secrets or private media.
